resources.string: The server has no speaker model installed, so it cannot learn a voice.

Wear the pendant as usual and read the sentences aloud in a quiet place, at your normal pace. Read for at least 30 seconds in all: with one language, read its sentences twice. While you read, the pendant\'s audio goes to the enrollment and not into a conversation.
Re-enroll starts over. Add more blends a new reading into your voiceprint, for example for another language.
The pendant is not sending audio. Connect it and unmute it.
The 120 second limit is reached. Send the reading.
Nytka deletes your voiceprint, every segment fingerprint and the labels made from them. Lines go back to the transcription service\'s labels. Your own \"this is me\" marks stay.
Nytka heard only %1$s of speech and needs at least 20 seconds. Read the sentences again, a little longer, with the pendant close.
The speech was too short to make 3 samples. Read for longer, without long pauses.
The samples do not sound like one voice. Record again somewhere quiet, with nobody else talking.
The server could not use this reading. Record again.
The reading is longer than 120 seconds. Record again and send it sooner.
The server could not read the audio. Record again.
Your voiceprint was made by another speaker model. Use Re-enroll to start over.
The pendant is not sending audio. Connect it and unmute it, then start again.
Nothing was recorded. Check that the pendant is connected and unmuted.
Back to the voice you enrolled.

string-array.name: voice_prompts_uk
string-array.item: Щоранку я п\'ю каву на балконі й дивлюся, як місто повільно прокидається.
Минулого літа ми їздили до Львова, гуляли старими вуличками та їли гарячі сирники.
Нагадай мені в четвер зателефонувати бабусі й забрати з пошти посилку від друга.

string-array.name: voice_prompts_ru
string-array.item: Вчера вечером мы долго гуляли по набережной и спорили о новых фильмах.
Если завтра будет дождь, я останусь дома, сварю борщ и почитаю интересную книгу.
Пожалуйста, перешли мне счёт за электричество до пятницы, чтобы я успел всё оплатить.

string-array.name: voice_prompts_en
string-array.item: The weather changed so quickly that we had to wait under the old bridge for the rain to pass.
I usually start my morning with a short walk, a strong coffee and a quick look at my calendar.
Could you remind me to call the dentist on Thursday and pick up fresh vegetables on the way home?
